annotations.title: Create or edit a DM automation (Instagram, Facebook, X)

description: Create (no id) or edit (id) an AUTO-DM / AUTO-REPLY automation: "when someone comments GUIDE on my posts, DM them my guide link", "reply to anyone who DMs PRICE with our pricing page", "reply to people who mention us on X". PAUSE one with {id, enabled:false}; PRACTICE MODE (dryRun:true) logs what it would send and sends nothing. Instagram/Facebook: a keyword comment (one post, the next post, any post; on Facebook also ads) gets a private reply in DMs/Messenger, a DM keyword or ig.me/m.me ref link gets a message, with optional link buttons and rotated public replies. X: a keyword @mention or a reply under your post gets a public reply, a DM keyword gets a DM (X allows an automated DM only after the person DMed you). Once per person per post; a DM saying STOP opts that person out. Instagram and Facebook are free; X is billed in credits for every mention, reply or DM X delivers to the account plus each reply or DM sent, and running out stops the X rules. It messages real people, so confirm the text first.

account.description: the account on that channel: @handle (Instagram, X) or Page name/id (Facebook); omit when only one is connected

channel.description: instagram (default), facebook (a Facebook Page: comments on its posts and ads, plus Messenger) or x

cooldownHours.description: DM/ref rules: answer one person at most once per this many hours (default 24)

dryRun.description: log what would be sent without sending

enabled.description: false pauses the automation without deleting it

followGate.description: Instagram only: followers get the content after tapping a button

ask.description: message asking the person to follow the account

button.description: label of the button the person taps once they follow

enabled.description: true = non-followers see the follow prompt before the content (Instagram only)

notFollowing.description: message sent to someone who does not follow yet

id.description: rule id to edit; omit to create a new automation

message.description: what the person receives: {text, buttons}; on X the text is the public reply, up to 280 characters

buttons.description: up to 3 link buttons (Instagram, Facebook; X has none)

text.description: what they receive; on X the public reply (280) or, for a dm rule, the DM

name.description: name of the automation, shown in the list

publicReplies.description: Instagram/Facebook comment rules: public replies under the comment, rotated

trigger.description: what starts the rule: {type, keywords, match, scope, mediaId, ...}; keywords are case-insensitive

keywords.description: case-insensitive words/phrases; empty = any comment (DM and mention rules need one)

match.description: contains (keyword appears in the text) or exact (whole text must equal the keyword)

mediaId.description: Instagram media id, Facebook post id (an ad: its effective_object_story_id) or X post id

scope.description: comment rules: one post (mediaId), the NEXT post you publish, or every post

type.description: comment (all; on X a reply under your post), dm (all), story_reply (Instagram), ref (ig.me/m.me link: Instagram, Facebook), mention (X)
